title: Your new Inbox
text: The inbox icon at the top right collects everything waiting for you: approvals, leave and phone requests, What's new and your own reminders and bookmarks.

title: Settings has a new home
text: Use the gear at the bottom of the menu. The tiles next to it jump to the modules you use most; the dashed button shows all your modules.

title: Search finds people and records
text: Press Ctrl K or click the search box: screens, quick actions, employees (name, PIN or ID number), farmers, contracts and assets.

title: Roles give everyone the same access
text: Saving a role now gives everyone with that role exactly what it shows. You see who changes before it saves, and you can undo it.
